services.name: Advanced Euro Nymphing Clinic
services.desc: Want to learn more from two of the best Euro Nymphers in the US? Well, there is no better chance than to work with Mike Slepesky and Joe Clark. Most of you know Mike, and have followed his work on the stream, Instagram. and YouTube. For those who do not know Joe Clark. he is a full time guide in Central Pennsylvania, with Josh Miller, and the TroutYeah Guide service. He recently was featured on the Fulling Mill YouTube channel, as a presenter on the Dry Dropper technique. Finally, Joe is currently coaching the Youth Fly Fishing Team USA and acting as a mentor/coach for 6 of our best young anglers nationwide. Join both of these phenomenal people and anglers as they share tips to unlock some
